In 100 cm or 1 m no of turns

= 1000 100 = 105 turns/m

No of turns, n = 105

Correctivity of ferromagnet, H = 100 A/m

As we know,

H = n I

I =

Current to demagnetise the ferromagnet = 1 mA.
